text:
maya: Quick sync—I'm worried our API key surface is still too porous for org/project boundaries.
aj: Agreed. We have a mix of project-scoped keys, org keys, and long-lived service keys. It's confusing.
sam: Can we define two primitives: 'user-scoped' (project) and 'service-scoped' (org) and keep operator/admin as a separate short-lived token?
maya: I like primitives. Tradeoff: lots of callers expect a single API key that works everywhere. We need a clear migration path.
sasha: Proposal: keep global org keys but mark them deprecated for new flows. New SDKs default to project-scoped keys and fail fast if missing perms.
aj: How about enforcement? Runtime should reject org-key use for project-scoped routes unless there's an explicit "cross-project" flag.
sam: That flag could be part of the claim: {"claims": {"cross_project": true}} and require admin approval to mint.
maya: Also: service-to-service auth. Do we keep minting proxy tokens (short TTL) or issue audience-scoped signed tokens?
sasha: Signed tokens (audience + route hints) are nicer for least-privilege, but adds complexity for token verification across infra. We could use short TTL + introspection endpoint as fallback.
aj: Ops concern: introspection increases load. We should cache verification results in edge proxies for TTL length.
ops-bot: NOTE: rollout-bot started canary of token-introspect-service v1.2 at 1712350050 :rocket:
sam: Migration step idea: SDKs detect org-key usage and emit telemetry + recommend creating project keys; platform offers one-click project key creation with minimal perms.
maya: We need an RBAC mapping table: role -> allowed routes, and a claim mapping for tokens. Keep it simple: role names: reader, writer, deployer, admin.
aj: For service roles, add "service:invoker" for event-driven callers.
sasha: Edge-case: third-party integrators who need org-wide access (billing partners). We'll keep org-keys for integrations but require scoped webhooks + signed callbacks.
maya: Can someone draft a short RFC with the primitives, token format example, and a migration checklist?
aj: I'll take the draft. Will include: token JSON example, policy YAML snippet, and SDK guidance.
sam: Example token snippet for RFC:
```
{
  "iss": "redwood-auth",
  "sub": "svc-metrics",
  "aud": "runtime-service",
  "exp": 1712353600,
  "claims": {"project":"proj-abc","roles":["service:invoker"]}
}
```
sasha: Also include runtime rule: if token has no "project" claim, it's org-scoped and must be explicitly allowed per route config.
maya: Great. Put RFC in docs, then ops + SDK teams will coordinate a 6-week migration with telemetry gates.
aj: I'll open a PR by EOW and ping leads for implementation slots.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed at 1712350290, no errors reported. :white_check_mark:
